meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任何文本背后的思维模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想了解别人或自己的思考方式
copy.tagline_en: Analyze thinking patterns behind any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand how someone thinks from their writing

howto.what: 装上后，当你提供任何文本，Claude 会提取作者的认知指纹：从 12 个维度评分、分析推理拓扑和决策模式，输出结构化认知画像。
howto.when: 当你要求分析某人如何思考、比较思考风格，或说“我的思考风格”“认知画像”“DHDNA”等关键词，或提供文本并想深入了解作者的推理模式时触发。

say.text: 分析这段文字的思考风格。
say.note: Claude 会对文本进行 12 维度评分并给出认知画像。

say.text: 比较这两篇文章作者的认知模式。
say.note: Claude 会分别画像并进行对比合成。

say.text: 帮我做一次自我认知画像。
say.note: Claude 会根据当前对话内容分析你的思维模式。

howto.what_en: When you provide any text, Claude extracts the author's cognitive fingerprint: scores on 12 dimensions, reasoning topology, and decision fingerprint, outputting a structured cognitive profile.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze how someone thinks, compare thinking styles, or say keywords like "cognitive profile", "DHDNA", or when you provide text and want deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns.

say_en.text: Analyze the thinking style of this text.
say_en.note: Claude will score 12 dimensions and output a cognitive profile.

say_en.text: Compare the cognitive patterns of these two passages.
say_en.note: Claude will profile each and produce a comparison synthesis.
Claude will analyze the conversation history as self-profile.
